description: Land Acquisition - Madurupitiya, Meerigama D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed descriptions of specific land parcels, including boundaries, extents, and locations, with orders authorizing the taking of possession of these lands. The content falls under "Land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazette (Type 4) classification criteria. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the land acquisition process and does not involve government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government-related classification.
